messages:
carl_release: kicking off conservative rollout for flag `predict-qos-v2` at 10% across eu-west and us-central. deploying model bundle v2.1. note: change window tonight 20:00-23:00 UTC. deploy-bot: [deployed predict-qos-v2 to canary pool] replica=3 region=eu-west status=passed

maya_sre: monitoring metrics — will watch p50/p95 latency and error-rate. set alert: qos-latency-eu > 120ms for 5m

juan_eng: quick heads up — v2.1 includes a new prefix-caching path. should be fine but watch small-token tails.

deploy-bot: rollout-stage: 10% -> started at 1718123456. canary-checks: health, infra, errorbudget

carl_release: plan: 10% -> 25% after 15m if no regressions. if p95 increases >15% or error-rate spikes >1% revert to v2.0. we may pin routing to v2.0 for specific customers if needed.

sasha_data: running A/B eval set-1 now. will post quick summary in 10m. key metric: response coherence and hallucination regressions.

alyssa_pm: note we already announced minor behavior change in release notes under 'model improvements' — ping CS if customers ask.

maya_sre: alert fired in eu-west on p95 at +18% (1718123600). digging in. adding temporary circuit for heavy-tail shard.

juan_eng: looking at logs — a specific node has kernel OOMs during KV expansion. killing pod and restarting 1/3. rolling restart triggered.

deploy-bot: canary health degraded: eu-west node-7 restarted. status=degraded

carl_release: decision time — do we pin traffic for eu-west back to v2.0 or roll back full flag to 0%? Preference: targeted pin by region to limit blast radius.

ops-scheduler: change window still open. we can perform region pin within 5m with LD toggle + routing pin. would you like me to execute?

carl_release: yes, pin eu-west to v2.0 (50% traffic) and pause global ramp. runbook: 1) update LD rule: region==eu-west -> predict-qos=v2.0 2) set rollout percentage to 0% global 3) notify customers if impacted.

ops-scheduler: executing step 1 now.

deploy-bot: LD rule updated: eu-west pinned to v2.0. global rollout percentage set to 0% at 1718123750.

maya_sre: after pin, p95 dropped back to baseline within 2 minutes. taking node-7 out of rotation for deeper trace. :thumbsup:

sasha_data: A/B eval aborted for eu-west segment. will re-run post root cause.

juan_eng: filing follow-up ticket ENG-4321 for KV expansion path bug and a patch for better guardrails.

alyssa_pm: updating release notes: add note about temporary regional pin and that v2.1 is paused in eu-west pending fix. cc: all CS teams.

carl_release: decision logged: regional pin instead of full rollback. we'll aim to re-run canary after patch and increased memory headroom. next steps: ENG triage (priority P1), SRE to monitor, PM to notify customers. thanks all.

deploy-bot: thread closed by carl_release at 1718124123
